mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1 AND ( v.`type` = 0 OR ( v.`type` = 1 AND sv.`stock` > 0 AND sv.`begin_time` <= NOW() AND sv.`end_time` >= NOW() ) ) ORDER BY v.`type` DESC, v.`update_time` DESC, v.`id` DESC

SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock`, sv.`begin_time`, sv.`end_time` FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id WHERE v.status = 1 AND ( v.`type` = 0 OR ( v.`type` = 1 AND sv.`stock` > 0 AND sv.`begin_time` <= NOW() AND sv.`end_time` >= NOW() ) ) ORDER BY v.`type` DESC, v.`update_time` DESC, v.`id` DESC

SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, s.`name` AS shopName, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock`, sv.`begin_time`, sv.`end_time` FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_shop s ON v.`shop_id` = s.`id` LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id WHERE v.status = 1 AND ( v.`type` = 0 OR ( v.`type` = 1 AND sv.`stock` > 0 AND sv.`begin_time` <= NOW() AND sv.`end_time` >= NOW() ) ) ORDER BY v.`type` DESC, v.`update_time` DESC, v.`id` DESC
SELECT v.`id` FROM tb_voucher v INNER JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.`id` = sv.`voucher_id` WHERE v.`type` = 1 AND sv.`end_time` < NOW()
